name: deep_research
description: Exhaustive multi-language research tool using multi-agent planning, execution, verification, iterative section-by-section report writing, final source review, and scoped Smart Patch editing. Proposes a plan first for user approval before full execution.

topic.description: Technical or complex topic to investigate.

approved.description: Set to true only if the user has approved the research plan. If false or omitted, the tool will propose a plan first.

feedback.description: User feedback or specific notes for adjusting the research plan.

resume.description: Resume the same research session from its latest validated checkpoint instead of restarting.

plan.description: The approved research plan structure (objectives and steps) to guide the search subagents.
